question: What are some advantages of using flaps during approaches and landings?

correct_answers.text: Producing greater lift and permitting lower approach and landing speeds
Producing greater drag and permitting a steeper descent angle
Increasing forward visibility by allowing a lower pitch

wrong_answers.text: Increasing the length of the landing roll
Causing a nose-up pitching moment in all airplanes

wrong_answers.text: Landing surface is soft and short

question: What is the primary purpose of an intentional slip in aviation?

wrong_answers.text: To stabilize the airplane in turbulence
To align with the runway centerline

question: What are the two types of intentional slips?

correct_answers.text: Sideslip
